Implement a simple event emitter class in Node (CommonJS).

```js
class Emitter {
  on(event, fn)      // subscribe, returns this (for chaining)
  off(event, fn)     // remove that handler (if fn is omitted, remove all handlers for the event)
  once(event, fn)    // run only once
  emit(event, ...args) // call handlers in registration order, return the listener count
}
module.exports = { Emitter };
```

Note: emit must be safe even if off is called during it (iterate over a snapshot),
and a once handler must be removed before it runs so that a re-entrant emit
cannot fire it twice.
